desktop.metaDescription: Buyer Protection Policy on Henry Onyx Marketplace — clear rules, buyer protection, and seller standards.

blocks.text: Henry Onyx receives your payment first, holds it through fulfillment, and can hold the seller's payout when delivery proof is missing or a dispute is open.
Henry Onyx holds your payment until your order is delivered and confirmed.
An open dispute holds the seller's payout on the affected order until it is resolved.
Verified delivery plus timeout can trigger payout release when buyers do not confirm promptly and no dispute exists.
